Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN

 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 temp_buffer := :control_block.contract_id;

 SELECT company 
 INTO :company 
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = temp_buffer AND
 contract_type = 'RG' AND
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND ----SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-260
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(temp_buffer, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND 
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10)
 ;

 NEXT_ITEM;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company 
 INTO :control_block.contract_id
 , :company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE company = temp_buffer AND 
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND --SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-260
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND 
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */ 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company 
 INTO:control_block.contract_id
 , :company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE UPPER(company) LIKE ('%'||temp_buffer || '%') AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10) AND 
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND --SOUKUM/06012018/MLT-260
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */
 contract_type = 'RG' 
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :control_block.contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :company := NULL;
 list_values;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('1147'); -- It was 5150 HCL-C
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :control_block.contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :company := NULL;
 LIST_VALUES;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO :global.x
 FROM batch_inputs
 WHERE batch_inputs.batch_id = :control_block.batch_id AND 
 batch_inputs.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('1097');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO :global.x
 FROM utrs ut 
 , units u
 WHERE u.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND
 u.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND
 u.batch_id = :control_block.batch_id AND
 u.unit_id = ut.unit_id AND
 ut.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND
 u.coll_date = TRUNC(ut.coll_date) AND
 u.qc_test_date IS NULL AND
 ut.test_id = NVL(:control_block.test_id,test_id) AND
 ut.result_status_1 IS NULL AND
 NVL(ut.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND
 NOT EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM rgt_interim_results rgt
 WHERE rgt.unit_id = u.unit_id AND
 rgt.chapter_id = u.chapter_id AND
 rgt.coll_date = u.coll_date AND
 rgt.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND
 rgt.test_id = ut.test_id AND
 rgt.test_seq_no = ut.test_seq_no
 )
 AND ROWNUM = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('1061');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 done BOOLEAN;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN

 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 IF (:control_block.interim IS NULL) 
 THEN
 show_error('1063');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF (:control_block.interim IS NOT NULL) 
 THEN
 --- added to populate the description field
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUBSTR(code_desc,1,27)
 INTO :GLOBAL.interim_desc
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'QCIRM' AND 
 code = :control_block.interim AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('1062');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;

 GO_RECORD(1);
 LOOP 
 IF (:interim.result_code IS NULL) 
 THEN
 :interim.result_code := :control_block.interim;
 :interim.desc := :GLOBAL.interim_desc;
 END IF;
 GO_BLOCK('interim');
 IF (:SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE') 
 THEN
 GO_RECORD(1);
 EXIT; 
 ELSE
 DOWN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE' then
 down;
 else
 show_error('1055');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 GO_RECORD(1);
 LOOP
 IF :interim.result_code IS NOT NULL 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO rgt_interim_results 
 (
 chapter_id
 , contract_id
 , unit_id
 , batch_id
 , test_id
 , test_seq_no
 , result_code
 , insert_user_id
 , insert_dats
 , program_id
 , coll_date
 ) 
 VALUES 
 (
 :control_block.chapter_id
 , :control_block.contract_id
 , :interim.unit_id
 , :control_block.batch_id
 , :interim.test_id
 , :interim.test_seq_no
 , :interim.result_code
 , :banner.user_id
 , SYSDATE
 , :banner.prog_name
 , :interim.coll_date
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD='FALSE' 
 THEN
 down;
 ELSE 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=5;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0;
 CLEAR_BLOCK;
 GO_BLOCK('control_block');
 CLEAR_BLOCK;
 :control_block.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_BATCH_ID_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select bu.batch_id, 
 to_char(received_date, 'MM-DD-YY'),
 substr(to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, bu.qc_date),'MM-DD-YY'),1,8), 
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, bu.received_date) received_date
from batch_inputs bu 
where chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
and exists (select 'x' 
 from units u,utrs ut 
 where u.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id 
 and u.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id 
 and u.unit_id = ut.unit_id 
 and u.chapter_id = ut.chapter_id 
 and u.coll_date = trunc(ut.coll_date) 
 and ut.result_status_1 is null 
 and u.batch_id=bu.batch_id 
 and not exists (select 'x' 
 from rgt_interim_results rgt 
 where rgt.unit_id = u.unit_id 
 and rgt.chapter_id = u.chapter_id 
 and rgt.coll_date = u.coll_date 
 and rgt.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id 
 and rgt.test_id = ut.test_id 
 and rgt.test_seq_no = ut.test_seq_no) ) 
order by 4 desc, 1
